surroundingDistrictNotes: Las Lomas High School (1460 S. Main St, Walnut Creek, CA 94596; llhs.acalanes.k12.ca.us) is owned by the Acalanes Union High School District, NOT Walnut Creek SD. Northgate High School (425 Castle Rock Rd, Walnut Creek, CA 94598; northgate.mdusd.org; Broncos, crimson & gold) is owned by the Mt. Diablo Unified School District, NOT Walnut Creek SD. Walnut Creek SD is K-8 only (legally 'Walnut Creek Elementary School District'), so its graduates feed into those two other districts' high schools — include them only if the demo wants the feeder-pattern story. Extra district branding data: district site theme is green (#004500 theme var, plus #006f00 and #8cab4f in page source); district logo: https://files.smartsites.parentsquare.com/7126/header_logo_img_ppobop.png; district motto 'Engage, Inspire, and Empower ALL Learners!'; phone (925) 944-6850; superintendent Marie Morgan; ~3,500 students. All 7 school sites are ParentSquare SmartSites on subdomains of walnutcreeksd.org, and every URL above was verified to load. Sources: walnutcreeksd.org + each school subdomain (addresses, mascots, logos, CSS hex), NCES/EdData/Yelp (address cross-checks), Nominatim + US Census geocoder (coordinates), Wikipedia/GreatSchools (HS district ownership).
